how_retrieved: robots.txt at https://www.aft-website.com/robots.txt discloses the WordPress install at /cms/ and the sitemap.
curl https://www.aft-website.com/sitemap.xml -> 4 child sitemaps (page, news, news-en, newslist_en).
curl https://www.aft-website.com/page-sitemap.xml -> 75 page URLs = the ENTIRE public site.
WordPress REST API is live: https://www.aft-website.com/cms/wp-json/wp/v2/media?per_page=100&page=N enumerates the whole media library.
Wayback CDX for the full history: curl 'https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=aft-website.com*&output=json&limit=100000&collapse=urlkey'

finding.no_sds_area: Ajinomoto Fine-Techno publishes NO SDS, NO MSDS and NO technical datasheet PDFs anywhere on aft-website.com. The entire public site is 75 pages. The WordPress media library contains exactly ONE PDF (an unrelated 2025 attachment) and the Wayback history contains only corporate/CSR PDFs (karadakokoro20NN.pdf). Every product page ends in a contact form (/contact/product-contact/?post_id=NNNN) instead of a download.
finding.confirms_previous_batch: This reproduces and extends the earlier batch finding that ABF product pages carry no SDS links - it is true of the WHOLE site, not just one product page.
finding.agl_1020_examination: 'AGL-1020' does not exist anywhere in Ajinomoto Fine-Techno's published material. 0 hits in the 75-page sitemap, 0 hits in 2211 archived URLs, 0 hits in the WP REST search. The ABF grade nomenclature is GX / GZ / GL, never AGL: the live EN+JP ABF page lists exactly GX-92, GX-T31, GZ-41, GL-102, and the 2013 archived page lists ABF-GX13, ABF-GX13GC, ABF-GX92, ABF-GZ41, ABF-LE, GX-T31.
